# Recreation Prompt

Create a mobile-first portrait browser game titled `Toadstool Dash: Meadow Run`. Preserve the source mechanics: a fixed-left player in an endless side-scrolling canvas platform runner, gravity-driven precise jumping, double jump, scrolling safe platforms, occasional hazard platforms after early score, score increment when safe platforms are passed, fall/hazard game over, and restart. Rebuild the presentation as a cheerful mushroom-meadow arcade platformer with Pip the cap-hopper, grassy brick ledges, coin-spark particles, question-block props, smiling hill scenery, soft clouds, bright family-friendly HUD copy, and touch-friendly controls. Use browser-native Canvas/CSS/JS in a single `index.html`; keep old runtime only as `_old` reference.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source truth
The preserved source (`index_old.html`) is a canvas endless side-scrolling platform runner. The player stays near the left side while platforms scroll left. The player can jump and double-jump; gravity pulls the player down; landing on normal platforms resets jump count; touching red kill platforms or falling below the viewport ends the run. Score increases when a normal platform is passed. Start, game-over, and restart screens gate the loop.

## Protected mechanics
- Canvas-based active loop driven by `requestAnimationFrame`.
- Fixed horizontal player position with scrolling platforms.
- Gravity, jump power, jump count, and double-jump input semantics.
- Collision rules for landing on safe platforms, failing on hazard platforms, and falling out of bounds.
- Score semantics: increment on passed normal platform, not on hazards.
- Start/restart click flow plus keyboard Space/ArrowUp and pointer/touch jump flow.

## Transformable surfaces
HUD wording, title, character silhouette, platform artwork, hazard artwork, background, particles, audio choices, GIF feedback, font identity, and onboarding copy are presentation-safe and were regenerated.

## Remixed target
`Toadstool Dash: Meadow Run` reframes the same runner as a bright mushroom-meadow arcade platformer with Pip the cap-hopper, brick ledges, question blocks, coin sparks, chompy stump traps, and compact portrait-first controls.
